name: mesh
description: A local-first causal collaboration room for humans and agents.

scripts.test: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @ai-mesh/room test && pnpm --filter @ai-mesh/runtime test && pnpm --filter @ai-mesh/store-sqlite test && pnpm --filter @ai-mesh/adapter-acp test && pnpm --filter @ai-mesh/adapter-native test && pnpm --filter @ai-mesh/collaboration test && pnpm --filter @ai-mesh/workspace test && pnpm --filter @ai-mesh/cli test && pnpm --filter @ai-mesh/evals test
scripts.verify: pnpm clean && pnpm exec tsc -b --force --pretty false && pnpm --filter @ai-mesh/desktop build:preload && pnpm --filter @ai-mesh/desktop build:renderer && pnpm check:exports && pnpm test && pnpm --filter @ai-mesh/evals eval all
